queries.query:
EmailUrlInfo
| where Url has_any ("1drv.ms", "sharepoint.com", "onedrive.live.com", "docs.google.com", "drive.google.com")
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where SenderFromDomain != "insidetechnologies.it" // filter out legitimate internal senders
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, Url, DeliveryAction
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Exchange Online Access from Unexpected Country
queries.description: Surfaces Exchange Online activity (read, send, delete) originating from countries outside the approved list — indicator of a compromised account operated by a remote threat actor (T1078 — Valid Accounts). Adapt the country filter.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft Exchange Online"
| where ActionType in ("MailItemsAccessed", "Send", "MoveToDeletedItems")
| where CountryCode !in ("IT", "US", "GB", "DE", "FR") // adapt to your policy
| summarize AccessCount = count() by AccountDisplayName, CountryCode, IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where AccessCount > 10
| order by AccessCount desc

queries.name: Executable or Macro-Enabled Attachments Delivered
queries.description: Surfaces emails with potentially dangerous attachments (exe, dll, ps1, docm, xlsm, etc.) that were successfully delivered to user inboxes, requiring manual triage to identify missed detections.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| where FileType in~ ("exe", "dll", "bat", "vbs", "js", "ps1", "docm", "xlsm", "xlam", "pptm")
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, FileType, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Internal Domain Impersonation (Lookalike Domains)
queries.description: Detects external emails using keywords associated with financial or urgent requests sent to internal recipients — BEC phishing using lookalike domains to trick employees (T1566 — Phishing). Update the domain filter.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where SenderFromDomain !endswith "insidetechnologies.it" // replace with your domain
| where Subject has_any ("fattura", "pagamento", "urgente", "password", "conferma", "invoice", "wire transfer", "urgent")
| where RecipientEmailAddress endswith "insidetechnologies.it"
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Malicious Attachment Hashes for IOC Sharing
queries.description: Extracts SHA256 hashes and filenames from malicious email attachments — ready to share as IOCs with other platforms or load into a Sentinel Watchlist.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Malware", "Phish")
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | project NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, Timestamp, DeliveryAction
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, FileType, SHA256, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Malicious Emails Delivered to Inbox (Missed Detections)
queries.description: Malware, phishing, or spam that bypassed filters and reached user inboxes — requires MDO policy review and potential user remediation.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Malware", "Phish", "Spam")
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| where DeliveryLocation in ("Inbox", "Inbox/folder")
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, ThreatTypes, DetectionMethods, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Malicious URLs from Emails — Blocklist Export
queries.description: Deduplicated list of malicious URLs found in email campaigns — ready as a blocklist for proxy/firewall or as a Sentinel Watchlist IOC feed.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Malware", "Phish")
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo
    | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
) on NetworkMessageId
| project NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, Url, UrlDomain, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction
| distinct Url, UrlDomain, ThreatTypes, SenderFromAddress
| order by UrlDomain asc

queries.name: Phishing Campaign Volume by Sender Infrastructure
queries.description: Groups phishing emails by sender domain and IPv4 to identify the most active campaigns — helps prioritize blocking and correlate domains/IPs from the same infrastructure.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where ThreatTypes has "Phish"
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| summarize
    EmailCount = count(),
    UniqueRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by SenderFromDomain, SenderIPv4
| order by EmailCount desc

queries.name: Phishing Spray — Same Sender to Many Recipients
queries.description: Identifies a single sender delivering the same subject to more than 15 recipients in one hour — pattern of a compromised account used as an internal phishing relay (T1566 — Phishing).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| where DeliveryAction in ("Delivered", "DeliveredAsSpam")
| summarize RecipientCount = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Recipients = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 20) by SenderFromAddress, Subject, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where RecipientCount > 15
| order by RecipientCount desc

queries.name: Retroactive IOC Sweep by Attachment Hash
queries.description: Searches all email history for a specific SHA256 hash from threat intelligence — how many emails with that attachment entered the organization and who received them, enabling rapid containment.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
let SuspiciousHash = "abc123def456..."; // replace with SHA256 from threat intel
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where SHA256 =~ SuspiciousHash
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | project NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, Timestamp, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, SHA256, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Sender Spoofing — DMARC/SPF Failure with Display Name Match
queries.description: Emails where the visible From address differs from the envelope sender and authentication checks fail — classic spoofing technique to impersonate trusted senders (T1566 — Phishing).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| where SenderFromAddress != SenderMailFromAddress
| where AuthenticationDetails has "dmarc=fail"
    or AuthenticationDetails has "spf=fail"
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction, AuthenticationDetails
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Single Message Timeline (Trace by NetworkMessageId)
queries.description: Full forensic reconstruction of a single email — all associated events (headers, attachments, URLs, delivery outcome) in one query. Replace the placeholder ID.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
let MsgId = "<NetworkMessageId_to_investigate>"; // replace with the NetworkMessageId
union
(EmailEvents | where NetworkMessageId == MsgId | extend EventType = "EmailEvent"),
(EmailAttachmentInfo | where NetworkMessageId == MsgId | extend EventType = "Attachment"),
(EmailUrlInfo | where NetworkMessageId == MsgId | extend EventType = "Url")
| project Timestamp, EventType, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, FileType, SHA256, Url, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation
| order by Timestamp asc

queries.name: Typosquatting — Lookalike Sender Domains
queries.description: Emails from domains typosquatting your organization's domain — advanced BEC using character substitution to impersonate internal senders (T1566 — Phishing). Update the domain and regex.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
let InternalDomain = "insidetechnologies.it"; // replace with your domain
EmailEvents
| where SenderFromDomain != InternalDomain
| where SenderFromDomain matches regex @"(inside.technologies|insidetecnologies|insidetecnology|inside-technologies|insideitechnologies)"
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction, ThreatTypes
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: User Clicks on Suspicious URLs Post-Delivery
queries.description: Tracks user clicks on external URLs from emails after delivery — identifies users who interacted with phishing links before or after Safe Links inspection.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
UrlClickEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailUrlInfo
    | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
) on NetworkMessageId, Url
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, UrlDomain, ActionType, IsClickedThrough, ThreatTypes
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: ZIP Attachment Correlated with Executable Extraction on Endpoint
queries.description: Correlates ZIP attachments delivered by email with executable files later extracted on endpoints — end-to-end kill chain visibility from delivery to execution (T1566.001 — Phishing: Spearphishing Attachment).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| where FileType =~ "zip"
| where SHA256 != ""
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | where AttachmentCount > 0
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, SHA256
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where FileName endswith ".exe"
) on $left.SHA256 == $right.SHA256
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| project Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, SHA256, DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Brute Force — Sign-in failures per user (last 24h)
queries.description: Identifies accounts with more than 10 failed sign-in attempts in the last 24 hours, grouped by user and IP address. Primary indicator of brute force or password spray attacks.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    DistinctIPs    = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPList         = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
    AppList        = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, UserDisplayName
| where FailedAttempts > 10
| order by FailedAttempts desc

queries.name: Credenziale aggiunta a Service Principal
queries.description: Monitors the addition of new credentials (passwords or certificates) to Service Principals and App Registrations. Common persistence technique: the attacker adds their own key to maintain access even after password rotation.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName in (
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management"
  )
| extend
    Actor          = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
    ActorIP        = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
    TargetApp      = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
    CredentialType = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[0].newValue)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, ActorIP, TargetApp, CredentialType, OperationName

queries.name: MFA Fatigue — Push MFA rifiutate ripetutamente
queries.description: Identifies users who have received more than 5 denied MFA push notifications within 1 hour. Used in MFA fatigue/push bombing attacks: the attacker floods the user with requests to wear them down until they accept.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AuthenticationDetails has "MFA"
| mv-expand todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| where AuthenticationDetails.authenticationMethod == "Mobile app notification"
      and AuthenticationDetails.succeeded == "false"
| summarize
    PushDenied = count(),
    IPList     = make_set(IPAddress, 5),
    Locations  = make_set(Location, 5)
  by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where PushDenied > 5
| order by PushDenied desc

queries.name: Sign-in from a country never seen before
queries.description: Finds users successfully signing in from countries they have never connected from in the past 2 weeks. Useful for detecting compromised accounts used by remote attackers.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
let lookback  = 14d;
let recentWin = 1d;
let known_countries = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(lookback) .. ago(recentWin))
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | distinct UserPrincipalName, KnownLocation = Location;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recentWin)
| where ResultType == "0"
| join kind=leftouter known_countries on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UserPrincipalName and $left.Location == $right.KnownLocation
| where isempty(KnownLocation)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Location, IPAddress, AppDisplayName

queries.name: Sign-ins from Multiple Countries in Short Time Window
queries.description: Detects user accounts with sign-in activity from more than one country in a 24-hour period — impossible travel indicator or credential sharing across regions (T1078 — Valid Accounts).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize
    START = min(TimeGenerated),
    END = max(TimeGenerated),
    CountPerCountry = dcount(Location),
    Nations = make_set(Location),
    CountPerCity = dcount(tostring(LocationDetails.city)),
    All_Cities = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.city))
    by UserPrincipalName
| where CountPerCountry > 1
| order by CountPerCountry desc

queries.name: Distinct Active Users (Excluding App Accounts)
queries.description: Lists distinct user accounts that have generated OfficeActivity events, excluding service/app accounts.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where UserId !contains "app@sharepoint"
| distinct UserId

queries.name: Email Trace — Specific Sender to Specific Recipient
queries.description: Retrieves all email messages between a specific sender and recipient pair. Use for targeted BEC investigation or delivery verification.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
EmailEvents
| where SenderFromAddress == "mittente@dominio.com"
| where RecipientEmailAddress == "destinatario@dominio.com"
| project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, DeliveryAction, Subject
| order by TimeGenerated desc

queries.name: Exchange Admin Operations — All Records
queries.description: Returns all ExchangeAdmin audit records — every administrative action taken in Exchange Online.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where RecordType == "ExchangeAdmin"

queries.name: Exchange Admin Operations Summary by Operation
queries.description: Aggregates Exchange Admin audit records by operation name — quick frequency view of which admin operations have been most recently executed.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where RecordType == "ExchangeAdmin"
| summarize AggregatedValue = count() by Operation

queries.name: M365 admin role assigned — privilege elevation
queries.description: Monitors the assignment of administrative roles in Microsoft 365. Any role elevation should be verified and approved by the IAM team.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OperationName == "Add member to role"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, TargetUser

queries.name: Mail Forwarding Rule verso dominio esterno
queries.description: Detects the creation of email forwarding rules pointing to addresses outside the organization — a very common exfiltration technique.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","New-TransportRule")
| where Parameters has_any ("ForwardTo","RedirectTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo")
| extend ForwardTo = extract(@"(?:ForwardTo|RedirectTo)[^|]+|([^|,s]+@[^|,s]+)", 1, tostring(Parameters))
| where ForwardTo !endswith "@contoso.com"
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, ForwardTo, Parameters

queries.name: Mail Rule Creation/Modification — Broad Coverage (CloudAppEvents)
queries.description: Catch-all hunting query over all inbox and transport rule operations via CloudAppEvents. Useful to spot any rule manipulation activity.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto

queries.name: Mailbox Delegation Added — Full Access or Send-As
queries.description: Detects Add-MailboxPermission and Add-RecipientPermission operations — attackers use this to silently read a victim's email without changing the password.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft Exchange Online"
| where ActionType in ("Add-MailboxPermission", "Add-RecipientPermission")
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ActionType, RawEventData

queries.name: Mass Email Deletion — possibile preparazione a ransomware
queries.description: Identifies users deleting an unusually high number of emails in a short time. May indicate ransomware clearing mailboxes, deliberate sabotage, or a compromised account.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in ("HardDelete","SoftDelete","MoveToDeletedItems")
| summarize DeletedCount = count(), FolderList = make_set(Folder, 5), IPList = make_set(ClientIP, 3) by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DeletedCount > 200
| order by DeletedCount desc

queries.name: O365 Audit — Inbox Rule Activity Summary (OfficeActivity)
queries.description: Aggregates inbox rule modification operations grouped by user, operation type, and source IP.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox")
| summarize Count = count() by UserId, Operation, ClientIP
| sort by Count desc

queries.name: OfficeActivity Event Count by User
queries.description: Aggregates all OfficeActivity events per user — quick overview of the most active accounts across all M365 workloads.
queries.mitreNotApplicable: Generic activity volume summary per user
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| summarize AggregatedValue = count() by UserId
| sort by AggregatedValue

queries.name: Send As Permission Granted — Full Impersonation
queries.description: Detects Add-RecipientPermission actions granting SendAs rights — emails are indistinguishable from legitimate ones sent by the victim.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft Exchange Online"
| where ActionType == "Add-RecipientPermission"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, RawEventData

queries.name: Send On Behalf — GrantSendOnBehalfTo Modified
queries.description: Detects Set-Mailbox operations that modify the GrantSendOnBehalfTo attribute. Common in BEC attacks to impersonate executives.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft Exchange Online"
| where ActionType == "Set-Mailbox"
| where RawEventData has "GrantSendOnBehalfTo"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, RawEventData

queries.name: File Server — File Events with Color-Coded Operations
queries.description: Surfaces file server events (create, rename, delete) ingested via the M365 connector with color-coded operation labels. Filters out system and admin actors. Verify that your connector populates the Div and related custom fields.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where Div contains "T0Rbody"
    and ActionUserType == "System"
    and ActorUserType <> "Service"
    and ActorUserType <> "Machine"
    and TargetWindowsUsername !contains "id autority"
    and ActorUsername !contains "admin"
    and TargetFilePath !contains "uhls"
    and EventProduct contains "M365"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(2h)
| project ActorUsername, EventProduct, Div, EventEndTime,
    EventResult = case(
        EventResult contains 'Success', '✅ Success',
        EventType contains 'Failure', '❌ Failure',
        'none'),
    EventType = case(
        EventType contains 'FileCreated',  '📁 FileCreated',
        EventType contains 'FileRenamed',  '📄 FileRenamed',
        EventType contains 'FileDeleted',  '🗑 FileDeleted',
        '❌ Unknown'),
    TargetFileName, FilePath
| order by EventEndTime

queries.name: Fortinet — All Events from Firewall
queries.description: Returns all CommonSecurityLog events from the Fortinet firewall. Use as a starting query to explore raw events, then add filters for specific device event classes, actions, or source/destination IPs.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where Computer contains "fw01" // replace with your firewall hostname

queries.name: Fortinet — CPU & Memory Utilization Over Time
queries.description: Extracts CPU percentage and memory usage values from Fortinet syslog messages (event class 40704 — performance) and renders them as a time chart. Useful for capacity monitoring and spike detection.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where Computer contains "fw01" // replace with your firewall hostname
| where DeviceEventClassID contains "40704"
| extend CPU = toint(extract("average CPU: (\\d+)", 1, Message))
| extend Memory = toint(extract("memory:\\s+(\\d+)", 1, Message))
| project TimeGenerated, CPU, Memory
| render timechart

queries.name: Beaconing — connessioni periodiche verso stesso IP esterno
queries.description: Detects hosts making very frequent connections to the same external IP over a 24-hour period. Typical pattern of C2 malware with a fixed beacon interval: high connection frequency to a single destination.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where CommunicationDirection == "Outbound"
| where not(DestinationIP matches regex @"^(10.|192.168.|172.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]).)")
| summarize
    Connections = count(),
    Ports       = make_set(DestinationPort, 5),
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DestinationIP
| where Connections > 50
| extend DurationH = round(datetime_diff("minute", LastSeen, FirstSeen) / 60.0, 1)
| where DurationH > 1
| order by Connections desc

queries.name: DNS Exfiltration — subdomini eccessivamente lunghi
queries.description: Identifies DNS queries with unusually long subdomains (>50 characters), a technique used to exfiltrate Base64/hex-encoded data over DNS — difficult to block with traditional proxies.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| extend SubLen = strlen(Name) - strlen(extract(@"([^.]+.[^.]+)$", 1, Name))
| where SubLen > 50
| where not(Name endswith ".windowsupdate.com")
| where not(Name endswith ".microsoft.com")
| summarize
    Queries     = count(),
    UniqNames   = dcount(Name),
    SampleNames = make_set(Name, 5)
  by ClientIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Queries > 20
| order by Queries desc

queries.name: Executable Files Uploaded to SharePoint
queries.description: Executables or scripts uploaded to SharePoint — potential internal malware distribution via shared links or automated workflows (T1105 — Ingress Tool Transfer).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
| where ActionType == "FileUploaded"
| where ObjectName endswith ".exe"
    or ObjectName endswith ".dll"
    or ObjectName endswith ".ps1"
    or ObjectName endswith ".bat"
    or ObjectName endswith ".msi"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, AdditionalFields, IPAddress
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: External Guest Invited to SharePoint Sites
queries.description: SharePoint sharing invitations sent to Gmail, Yahoo, or other personal email accounts — potential exfiltration to personal accounts or unauthorized external parties (T1567 — Exfiltration Over Web Service).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
| where ActionType == "SharingInvitationCreated"
| where AdditionalFields has "#EXT#"
    or AdditionalFields has "gmail.com"
    or AdditionalFields has "yahoo.com"
    or AdditionalFields has "hotmail.com"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, AdditionalFields, IPAddress
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Files Shared via Public Anonymous Links
queries.description: Corporate files made publicly accessible without authentication via "Anyone with the link" sharing — critical DLP violation, potential intentional or accidental exfiltration (T1567.002 — Exfiltration to Cloud Storage).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application in ("Microsoft SharePoint Online", "Microsoft OneDrive")
| where ActionType == "SharingSet"
| where AdditionalFields has "Anyone"
    or AdditionalFields has "AnonymousLink"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, AdditionalFields, IPAddress
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Mass File Deletion from SharePoint/OneDrive
queries.description: More than 50 files deleted from cloud storage in one hour — deliberate sabotage or ransomware also targeting OneDrive-synced files (T1485 — Data Destruction).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application in ("Microsoft SharePoint Online", "Microsoft OneDrive")
| where ActionType == "FileDeleted"
| summarize DeletedCount = count(), Files = make_set(ObjectName, 10) by AccountDisplayName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DeletedCount > 50
| order by DeletedCount desc

queries.name: Mass File Download from SharePoint
queries.description: More than 100 file downloads from SharePoint/OneDrive in one hour — typical of an insider threat or compromised account bulk-collecting documents before exfiltration (T1530 — Data from Cloud Storage).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application in ("Microsoft SharePoint Online", "Microsoft OneDrive")
| where ActionType == "FileDownloaded"
| summarize DownloadCount = count(), Files = make_set(ObjectName, 20) by AccountDisplayName, IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DownloadCount > 100
| order by DownloadCount desc

queries.name: Mass File Rename on OneDrive (Ransomware Sync)
queries.description: OneDrive syncing ransomware encryptions from a local device — early detection via high rename volume before all cloud versions are overwritten (T1486 — Data Encrypted for Impact).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft OneDrive"
| where ActionType == "FileRenamed"
| summarize RenamedCount = count(), NewExtensions = make_set(tostring(split(ObjectName, ".")[-1])) by AccountDisplayName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where RenamedCount > 50
| order by RenamedCount desc

queries.name: Sensitive Files Modified in SharePoint
queries.description: Modifications to files with names indicating sensitive content (contracts, budget, salary, M&A, confidential) — DLP monitoring for high-value documents (T1565 — Data Manipulation).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
| where ActionType in ("FileModified", "FileCheckedOut", "FileVersionsAllDeleted")
| where ObjectName has_any ("contratto", "offerta", "budget", "salary", "stipendi", "M&A", "confidential", "riservato")
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, AdditionalFields, IPAddress, SiteUrl = tostring(AdditionalFields.SiteUrl)
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: SharePoint Activity Count by User (14 days)
queries.description: Counts SharePoint events per user over the past 14 days. Baseline for identifying unusually active users or accounts with abnormal SharePoint interaction volumes.
queries.mitreNotApplicable: Generic activity volume baseline per user
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where EventSource == "SharePoint"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize count() by UserId

queries.name: SharePoint Downloads via Suspicious User Agent (Script/Tool)
queries.description: File downloads using HTTP library user agents (python-requests, curl, wget, go-http-client) instead of browsers — automated exfiltration via script with stolen OAuth tokens (T1530 — Data from Cloud Storage).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
| where ActionType == "FileDownloaded"
| extend UserAgent = tostring(AdditionalFields.UserAgent)
| where UserAgent has_any ("python-requests", "curl", "wget", "go-http-client", "scrapy", "libwww")
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, UserAgent, IPAddress
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: SharePoint File Access from Non-Corporate IP
queries.description: File downloads from public IPs outside corporate/VPN ranges — potential access from an unmanaged device or compromised account (T1078.004 — Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts). Adapt IP ranges.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application in ("Microsoft SharePoint Online", "Microsoft OneDrive")
| where ActionType in ("FileDownloaded", "FileRead", "FilePreviewed")
| where IPAddress !startswith "10." // adapt to your corporate IP ranges
    and IPAddress !startswith "192.168."
    and IPAddress !startswith "172."
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, ObjectName, IPAddress, CountryCode, Application
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: SharePoint File & Folder Activity (Color-Coded Operations)
queries.description: Complete view of SharePoint file and folder events over 7 days with color-coded operation labels. Covers create, modify, delete, access, and upload events across files and folders, including the managing device.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where EventSource == "SharePoint"
| where ItemType == "File" or ItemType == "Folder"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, OfficeWorkload, Site_Url, SourceFileName, SourceFileExtension,
    Operation = case(
        Operation contains 'FolderCreated', '📁 FolderCreated',
        Operation contains 'FolderModified', '📁 FolderModified',
        Operation contains 'FolderDeleted', '❌ FolderDeleted',
        Operation contains 'FileAccessed', '📁 FileAccessed',
        Operation contains 'FileModified', '📁 FileModified',
        Operation contains 'FileDeleted', '❌ FileDeleted',
        Operation contains 'FileUploaded', '📁 FileUploaded',
        'other'
    ), IsManagedDevice
| order by TimeGenerated

queries.name: SharePoint File Uploads by Filename (14 days)
queries.description: Ranks most frequently uploaded filenames on SharePoint over 14 days, sorted by volume. Identifies specific files or file patterns being repeatedly uploaded.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where EventSource == "SharePoint"
    and Operation == "FileUploaded"
    and TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize AggregatedValue = count() by SourceFileName
| sort by AggregatedValue desc

queries.name: SharePoint File Uploads by User (14 days)
queries.description: Counts FileUploaded operations per user on SharePoint over 14 days. Helps identify bulk uploaders that may be staging data for external sharing.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where EventSource == "SharePoint"
    and Operation == "FileUploaded"
    and TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize AggregatedValue = count() by UserId

queries.name: Versioning Disabled on SharePoint Libraries
queries.description: Disabling versioning on SharePoint document libraries removes the ability to recover from malicious modifications or ransomware — sabotage of resilience controls (T1485 — Data Destruction).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
| where ActionType == "ListUpdated"
| where AdditionalFields has "EnableVersioning"
    and AdditionalFields has "false"
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, AdditionalFields, IPAddress, SiteUrl = tostring(AdditionalFields.SiteUrl)
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Veeam Backup Job Status (Syslog)
queries.description: Parses Veeam Backup & Replication syslog messages to surface backup job outcomes with color-coded status (success ✅, warning ⚠️, failure ❌). Update the Computer filter to match your Veeam server hostname.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
Syslog
| where Computer contains "tck01" // replace with your Veeam server hostname
| extend BackupStatus = iff(SyslogMessage contains "has been completed" and SeverityLevel == "info", "✅",
        iff(SyslogMessage contains "has been completed" and SeverityLevel == "warn", "⚠️",
            iff(SyslogMessage contains "has not been completed" and SeverityLevel == "error", "❌", "⚠️")))
| extend SeverityLabel = case(
    SeverityLevel contains "info",  "✅ Success",
    SeverityLevel contains "error", "❌ Failure",
    'none')
| project EventTime, BackupStatus, SeverityLevel, SeverityLabel, SyslogMessage
| sort by EventTime desc

queries.name: Access to Exposed Admin Panels on Public Internet
queries.description: Connections to well-known admin panel paths (/wp-admin, /phpmyadmin, /.env) on public IPs — reconnaissance or exploitation attempts against internet-facing web assets (T1190 — Exploit Public-Facing Application).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("/wp-admin", "/admin", "/phpmyadmin", "/cpanel", "/.env", "/wp-config.php", "/adminer")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Access to Unauthorized Anonymous File Sharing Services
queries.description: Connections to anonymous file sharing sites (WeTransfer, gofile.io, anonfiles, etc.) that are often used for exfiltration since they require no authentication and are rarely blocked by proxies (T1567 — Exfiltration Over Web Service).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (
    "wetransfer.com", "sendspace.com", "filedropper.com",
    "anonfiles.com", "upload.ee", "gofile.io",
    "temp.sh", "0x0.st", "file.io"
)
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Browser Downloads from Suspicious TLD Domains
queries.description: Correlates browser network connections and file downloads from domains with suspicious TLDs (.xyz, .top, .tk, etc.) — identifies malware downloaded via browser from ephemeral infrastructure.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe")
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has "Downloads"
) on DeviceName, $left.Timestamp == $right.Timestamp
| where RemoteUrl matches regex @"\.(xyz|top|club|online|site|tk|ml|ga|cf)\b"
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, FileName, FolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Connections to Known Malicious Domains (Threat Intel)
queries.description: Matches outbound connections against a list of known C2 or phishing domains. In production, replace the placeholder list with a Sentinel Watchlist fed by a threat intelligence source (TAXII/STIX, Microsoft MDTI).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (
    "malware-c2.example.com",   // replace with IOCs from your threat intel feed
    "phishing-kit.example.net"  // use a Sentinel Watchlist in production
)
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Connections to Sites with Invalid Certificates
queries.description: Failed connections due to certificate errors (expired, self-signed, invalid CA) — often indicative of C2 proxies or phishing sites with cheap or improperly configured HTTPS (T1071.001 — Web Protocols).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionFailed"
| where AdditionalFields has "CertificateError"
    or AdditionalFields has "SSL_ERROR"
    or AdditionalFields has "CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID"
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, AdditionalFields, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: Connections to Tor Entry/Exit Ports
queries.description: Outbound connections on Tor standard ports (9050, 9051, 9150, 9001, 9030) — used to anonymize C2 traffic, bypass DLP, and make exfiltration untraceable (T1090.003 — Multi-hop Proxy).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemotePort in (9050, 9051, 9150, 9001, 9030)
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: DNS over HTTPS to Non-Corporate Resolvers
queries.description: Non-browser processes connecting to public DoH resolvers (Google, Cloudflare, Quad9) — bypass of corporate DNS controls to hide C2 domain resolution queries (T1071.004 — DNS).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemotePort == 443
| where RemoteIP in (
    "8.8.8.8", "8.8.4.4",           // Google
    "1.1.1.1", "1.0.0.1",           // Cloudflare
    "9.9.9.9",                       // Quad9
    "208.67.222.222", "208.67.220.220" // OpenDNS
)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe")
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: High-Volume DNS Queries to a Single Domain
queries.description: More than 500 DNS queries to the same domain in one hour — DNS tunneling C2 pattern where commands are hidden in DNS query subdomains at high frequency (T1071.004 — DNS).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| summarize QueryCount = count() by DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where QueryCount > 500
| order by QueryCount desc

queries.name: Paste Sites Accessed by Non-Browser Processes
queries.description: Access to Pastebin, GitHub Gist, or similar paste sites from non-browser processes (PowerShell, cmd) — technique to download C2 configs or payloads from trusted-looking services (T1102 — Web Service).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("pastebin.com", "gist.github.com", "paste.ee", "hastebin.com", "dpaste.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "iexplore.exe")
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: System Processes Making Cleartext HTTP Connections
queries.description: Windows system processes (svchost, rundll32, regsvr32) making plain HTTP connections to the internet — potential C2 beacon using HTTP to evade TLS inspection (T1071.001 — Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols).
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where RemotePort == 80
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("svchost.exe", "wuauclt.exe", "msiexec.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe")
| extend AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc

queries.name: CPU Utilization Over Time (Perf)
queries.description: Tracks average CPU utilization for a Windows computer using the Perf table. Shows _Total processor time per minute. Replace the Computer filter with your target hostname.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
Perf
| where Computer contains "ltm01.xshypo1" // replace with your computer name
| where ObjectName == "Processor Information"
| where CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| where InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc

queries.name: Disk Read/Write Throughput Over Time (Perf)
queries.description: Tracks average disk read and write throughput in MB/sec for logical disks. Side-by-side view of both metrics helps identify I/O bottlenecks or unusual storage activity.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
Perf
| where (ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "Disk Read Bytes/sec")
    or (ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "Disk Write Bytes/sec")
| extend Metric = case(
    CounterName == "Disk Read Bytes/sec",  "Disk Read (MB/sec)",
    CounterName == "Disk Write Bytes/sec", "Disk Write (MB/sec)",
    "Other"
)
| extend CounterValue_MB = CounterValue / pow(1024, 2) // convert bytes to megabytes
| summarize AvgValue = avg(CounterValue_MB) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Metric, Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc

queries.name: Memory — Committed Bytes Over Time (Perf)
queries.description: Tracks committed memory in GB for a Windows computer over time. Useful for detecting memory leaks, capacity planning, or correlating resource exhaustion with security events.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
Perf
| where Computer contains "ltm01.xshypo1" // replace with your computer name
| where ObjectName == "Memory"
| where CounterName == "Committed Bytes"
| summarize AvgMemoryGB = avg(CounterValue / pow(1024, 3)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc

queries.name: Backdoor Account — creazione + aggiunta ad Administrators
queries.description: Correlates Event 4720 (account created) and Event 4732 (added to Administrators group) on the same computer within a 5-minute window. Classic persistence technique for creating an elevated backdoor account.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
let created = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4720
    | project CreatedAt = TimeGenerated, NewAccount = TargetAccount,
              Computer, SubjectAccount;
let added = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4732
    | where TargetUserName == "Administrators"
    | project AddedAt = TimeGenerated, AddedAccount = MemberName, Computer;
created
| join kind=inner added on Computer
| where AddedAccount has NewAccount
| where AddedAt between (CreatedAt .. (CreatedAt + 5m))
| project CreatedAt, Computer, NewAccount, SubjectAccount, AddedAt

queries.name: Kerberoasting — TGS requests with RC4 encryption (Event 4769)
queries.description: Detects potential Kerberoasting attacks: TGS requests using RC4-HMAC encryption (type 0x17), preferred by attackers because it is easier to crack offline than AES. Spikes in requests from a single IP are suspicious.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4769
| where EventData has "0x17"  // RC4-HMAC
| where ServiceName !endswith "$"       // escludi computer account
| where IpAddress !in ("127.0.0.1","::1")
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    Accounts = make_set(Account, 5),
    Services = make_set(ServiceName, 10)
  by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Requests > 5
| order by Requests desc

queries.name: Pass-the-Hash — Logon NTLM anomali verso workstation
queries.description: Identifies network logons using NTLM authentication (Logon Type 3) to workstations: in a properly configured Kerberos environment these should not occur between clients. Indicator of pass-the-hash or weak credentials.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4624
| where LogonType == 3
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where WorkstationName !in ("", "-")
| where not(IpAddress in ("127.0.0.1","::1"))
| summarize
    NTLMLogins = count(),
    Sources    = make_set(IpAddress, 10),
    Targets    = make_set(Computer, 10)
  by TargetUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where NTLMLogins > 5
| order by NTLMLogins desc

queries.name: Windows Event ID Filter (Custom EventID)
queries.description: Returns all Windows events matching a specific EventID over 14 days. Replace 5000 with any EventID of interest. Useful as a template for event-based alerting and custom security event analysis.
queries.author: Silvio Di Benedetto
queries.query:
Event
| where EventID == 5000 // replace with the EventID to investigate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
